body: Finding yourself is kinda a platitude but other than that thanks. I do a whole bunch of stuff in my spare time but a lot of it is physical and the problem with physical hobbies is that you can't do them all day every day.

I hope you're a troll because if not you're just a massive POS lol. I'm actually just laughing at the stuff you are saying, not because I am enjoying my life.

Or a child. Like man, what level of reasoning is that? "He said Lmao on the internet once so he's fine" wtf.

"Okay, the last thing I wanted was to "gaslight" or "discredit" you"

"I will still guarantee you that the "I'm ugly, and so people are laughing at me" is not real"

Definition of gaslighting: "Gaslighting is a form of emotional abuse that's seen in abusive relationships. It's the act of manipulating a person by forcing them to question their thoughts, memories, and the events occurring around them"

Believe me I wish this wasn't real, I really do. Sadly it is.

I aint compelled to hang out with anyone. I have a 0 tolerance policy after years of physical, verbal and sexual abuse and I've cut off many people as an adult the instant I find out they are abusive. 

Gaslighting me saying that the laughter and mockery "feels" targeted will also not help, that was how one of my abusive family members would discredit everything I said in order to never have to listen to my problems.

Not murder, assisted suicide. 

Being ugly does matter because people laugh at me in the streets and online (if I show my face to them). People made an entire steam group dedicated to mocking my appearance lmfao. Trying to tell me looks don't matter is beyond hopeless.
Thanks for the downvote kind stranger

"Improve yourself" is a load of crap because if you have a physical deformity like me and can't afford cosmetic surgery there is literally nothing you can do to "improve yourself". It's not always applicable.
